name: Memucan
overview: Memucan is identified as one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who held high positions in King Ahasuerus's court. In the critical moment when Queen Vashti refused the king's command, Memucan boldly counseled the king, emphasizing that her disobedience was not only a personal affront but also a threat to the authority of all the princes and subjects across the kingdom. He warned that Vashti's actions would set a dangerous precedent, leading women to despise their husbands and causing widespread contempt and unrest. Consequently, Memucan advised that a royal decree be issued to permanently remove Vashti from her position, ensuring the king's authority remained unchallenged and his rule stable.
